_comment: Vertical 9:16 cut of bloomberg-tech.json. Sizes are the broadcast measurement scaled by 26/42, which keeps the PROPORTIONS that make it read as Bloomberg (pad_y = 0.67 cap, rule = 0.33 cap, square corners) while fitting a 1080-wide frame. In the 9:16 cut this card IS the Bloomberg banner -- the source's own banner is outside the crop. bottom_margin_px 816 puts the card ABOVE the speaker's head, and that is measured, not a taste: clearing Bloomberg's own lower third forces crop_zoom up to ~1.7, which magnifies the face until the face box reaches y~1345 while the Shorts UI starts around y~1540 -- a 174 px two-line card does not fit between them. Below-the-face and above-the-Shorts-UI are mutually exclusive at this framing, so the card goes above. Verify with scripts/check-caption-space.py after ANY crop change; the first render of this preset sat straight across two speakers' mouths.

_measured._note: The measurements themselves live in bloomberg-tech.json; these are those numbers x 26/42.
_measured.shorts_safe_area: Lenny's Podcast parks its box 602 px above the frame bottom, which is the right number for a LOOSE framing and is what this preset used to use. It is wrong here: at this crop 602 px lands on the mouth. Kept as the reference point, not as the setting.
_measured.uppercase_cost: uppercase runs ~15% wider than sentence case, which is why max_words is 3 here against 4 in the sentence-case Lenny preset
_measured.caption_space: face box bottom reaches y=1345 and mouth landmarks y=1130..1215 at crop_zoom 1.556-1.714; card top at 816 -> ~296, card bottom ~470, face top >= 519
_measured.grouping_swept: Swept with the builder's wrap/orphan counters on clip 02. 4 words x width 500 -- what this shipped with -- wrapped 35% of cards and orphaned 10 single words onto their own line. 3 x 560 gives 4% and 2. Uppercase runs ~15% wider than sentence case, so 3 words is its natural cap here, not 4. Width 560 is clamped by the builder to 0.94*frame - 2*pad_x = 958 px, which is why 560 and 620 measure identically.
_measured.punctuation: UNMEASURABLE from their broadcast: the banner shows single headlines ('NVIDIA IN ADVANCED TALKS FOR HUGGING FACE'), which never carry running-speech punctuation, so there is nothing to copy. strip_trailing ',' is therefore a CHOICE inherited from red-card, kept because stripped commas fit the headline register the uppercase card imitates. Not an oversight -- unlike the Lenny preset, where the same inheritance contradicted a measurable habit and was removed.
_measured.wrap_policy: wrap 'none' is measured, not taste: Bloomberg's own strap is a single-line banner (e.g. 'HUMANOID ROBOTS ENTER SCALE-UP ERA: BARCLAYS'), so a card here never wraps -- grouping carries fewer words instead. This retires the per-clip max_words sweep the 'HORRENDOUS JOB / HORRENDOUS' defect forced (2026-09-03): widening was dead (scale_style clamps max_line_width_px to 0.94*W - 2*pad_x), and per-clip numbers are the anti-pattern docs/todo.md diagnoses.

overlays._note: Colour of the SOURCE video's own lower-third graphics to dodge (not your card colour). Targeted mode is reliable; auto is experimental and false-positives on saturated props.
